name: Encendido
units: robot: score units (reachy_dance/pose.py); human: HumanPose (xr/src/stage-types.d.ts), 3D joints via xr/src/body.ts

text.you: Frozen: knees soft, arms dead, head hanging.
text.A: Asleep: head down, antennas drooped, breathing slowly.

text.you: Stay frozen, breathing.
text.A: Asleep: head down, antennas drooped, breathing slowly.

text.you: Stay frozen.
text.A: Wakes on 3 to 5, scans the room with a big body turn, finds you on 7.
text.B: Still asleep, dreaming: an antenna twitches.

text.you: Head glitch on {2}: twitch sideways and drop again.
text.A: Wakes on 3 to 5, scans the room with a big body turn, finds you on 7.
text.B: Still asleep, dreaming: an antenna twitches.

text.you: Frozen, head down.
text.A: Leans toward you, tilting; taps the air twice toward Reachy 2.
text.B: Wakes on 6, stretches its antennas, looks at you.

text.you: Failed boot: head jerks halfway up on {1}, collapses on {3}.
text.A: Leans toward you, tilting; taps the air twice toward Reachy 2.
text.B: Wakes on 6, stretches its antennas, looks at you.

text.you: Hold still, head low.
text.A: Droops toward you, looks at Reachy 2 on 5, two small nods on 7 and 8.
text.B: Droops, then looks back and nods.

text.you: Small breath on {1}, then hold.
text.A: Droops toward you, looks at Reachy 2 on 5, two small nods on 7 and 8.
text.B: Droops, then looks back and nods.

text.you: A small shoulder jolt on every count.
text.A: Points its antenna at you and pulses it on every beat.

text.you: Keep jolting; your head rises in ticks on {1} to {4}.
text.A: Points its antenna at you and pulses it on every beat.

text.you: Head up on {1}, right arm out on {3}, forearm up on {4}.
text.A: Watches, then cheers each tick: antennas pop on 3, 5 and 7.

text.you: Left arm out on {1}, forearm down on {2}, head ticks to Reachy 1 on {3} and Reachy 2 on {4}.
text.A: Watches, then cheers each tick: antennas pop on 3, 5 and 7.

text.you: Stiff robot steps toward Reachy 1; look up at it on {4}.
text.A: Greets you with an antenna pop when you reach it on 4, then watches you cross.
text.B: Tracks you, then greets you on 8.

text.you: Robot steps across toward Reachy 2; look up at it on {4}.
text.A: Greets you with an antenna pop when you reach it on 4, then watches you cross.
text.B: Tracks you, then greets you on 8.

text.you: Lean back surprised at Reachy 1 on {3} and at Reachy 2 on {4}.
text.A: Hides on 1 and 2, pops up on 3, pops again on 7, laughs on 8.
text.B: Pops up on 4, a beat after Reachy 1; pops on 7, laughs on 8.

text.you: Hands over your face on {1} and {2}, open them on {3}, laugh on {4}.
text.A: Hides on 1 and 2, pops up on 3, pops again on 7, laughs on 8.
text.B: Pops up on 4, a beat after Reachy 1; pops on 7, laughs on 8.

text.you: Hands to your head on {1}, throw them back on {2}, shake out on {3} and {4}.
text.A: Recoils in surprise on 2, then nods on every beat; leans in when you step its way.

text.you: Step-touch toward Reachy 1 on {1} and {2}, toward Reachy 2 on {3} and {4}.
text.A: Recoils in surprise on 2, then nods on every beat; leans in when you step its way.

text.you: Funky chicken: elbows flap on every count, head pecks forward.
text.A: Pecks on odd counts, then in unison on 5 to 8.
text.B: Pecks on even counts, then in unison.

text.you: Funky chicken with knee pops on every count.
text.A: Pecks on odd counts, then in unison on 5 to 8.
text.B: Pecks on even counts, then in unison.

text.you: Skip toward Reachy 1, then upstage.
text.A: Turns head and body to follow you all the way around.

text.you: Skip past Reachy 2 and back to center.
text.A: Turns head and body to follow you all the way around.

text.you: Spin with arms out on {1} and {2}, land in a V on {3}, hold on {4}.
text.A: Dizzy head circles on 1 to 4; turns its back on 5 and 6, whips around on 7, ta-da on 8.

text.you: Hold the V and watch the robots spin; ta-da on {4}.
text.A: Dizzy head circles on 1 to 4; turns its back on 5 and 6, whips around on 7, ta-da on 8.

text.you: Running man.
text.A: Head-bangs on every beat; antennas run like arms; body swings.

text.you: Running man.
text.A: Head-bangs on every beat; antennas run like arms; body swings.

text.you: Running man, turning a half circle.
text.A: Spiral head moves while turning to keep facing you.

text.you: Running man, finishing the full circle.
text.A: Spiral head moves while turning to keep facing you.

text.you: Windmill arms on {1} and {2}, hand roll on {3} and {4}.
text.A: Antennas circle like arms; pops when you sweep its way on 5; halo on 7 and 8.
text.B: Opposite phase; pops on 6; halo on 7 and 8.

text.you: Sweep toward Reachy 1 on {1} and Reachy 2 on {2}, arms in a halo on {3} and {4}.
text.A: Antennas circle like arms; pops when you sweep its way on 5; halo on 7 and 8.
text.B: Opposite phase; pops on 6; halo on 7 and 8.

text.you: Your head ticks to whichever robot just moved, on every count.
text.A: Ping-pong: snaps to a new corner on 1 and 3, then unison on 5 to 8.

text.you: Robot arm hits on every count, with both robots.
text.A: Ping-pong: snaps to a new corner on 1 and 3, then unison on 5 to 8.

text.you: A wave travels through your arms toward Reachy 2 on {2} and {3}.
text.A: Starts the wave on 1, catches it back on 8.
text.B: Catches it on 4, sends it back on 5.

text.you: The wave comes back toward Reachy 1 on {2} and {3}.
text.A: Starts the wave on 1, catches it back on 8.
text.B: Catches it on 4, sends it back on 5.

text.you: Running man.
text.A: Head-bangs on 1 to 4, then robot hits on 5 to 8, in unison with you.

text.you: Robot arm hits on every count.
text.A: Head-bangs on 1 to 4, then robot hits on 5 to 8, in unison with you.

text.you: Jump with arms up on {1} and {3}.
text.A: Celebrates on 1 to 4, then leans in toward you, antennas high.

text.you: Snap into a power pose on {1}: one arm up, other hand on hip. Hold.
text.A: Celebrates on 1 to 4, then leans in toward you, antennas high.
